title: fix(plugin-auth): an organization delete counts the self-registration grant as the organization's own auth structure
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuG3QUP99tnEeXn4KB8zigwv)_

Fixes #32787

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删除组织时，把「自注册授权」（自助注册的人加入第一个组织时，平台按部署声明的 `selfRegistrationPermissionSet` 自动给的那条权限集记录）算作组织自身结构，和组织管理员授权一样：不计入「还拥有的记录」，随组织一起删掉。别的权限集授权照旧计数、照旧拒绝删除。
- 为什么改：托管上每个自助注册用户的第一个组织都删不掉，报 409「还拥有 sys_user_permission_set (1)」；第二个组织没有这条记录，能正常删。
- 风险与回滚：授权只在它所属的组织被激活时生效，组织删掉后这条记录在哪儿都不起作用，所以删掉它不改变这个人在其他组织里的任何权限（已在第二个组织上前后实测，完全相同）；默认组织的删除不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-delete.ts`（`organizationAuthStructureSetNames` 与计数、删除两处）、`auth-manager-actor-guards.ts`（删除前检查传入部署声明的集合名）、`auth-manager-organization-plugin.ts`（`beforeDeleteOrganization` 同样传入）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/organization-delete.test.ts`，应见 `[#32787]` 六条全绿：自注册授权不计数、随组织删除，别的集合仍计数，未声明集合时照旧计数。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`POST /auth/organization/delete` (maintainer ruling on #24948, letter B) refuses while an organization still owns records and removes the organization's own auth structure with it. That structure included only the organization-admin grants among `sys_user_permission_set` rows. A self-registrant's first membership also lands a grant there: the set the deployment's audience declares (`audience.selfRegistrationPermissionSet`), owned by that organization (ADR-0131 D3/D9, `AuthManager#settleSelfRegistrationGrant`; a second membership writes no second one). The delete counted it as a record, so every self-registrant's first organization answered `409 DELETE_RESTRICTED` naming `sys_user_permission_set (1)`.

- **`organization-delete.ts`: `organizationAuthStructureSetNames(selfRegistrationSet)`**, the sets whose grants in an organization are its own structure: the two organization-admin sets, plus the declared self-registration set when there is one, each once. `organizationDeleteRefusal` subtracts the grants of exactly these sets from the organization's grant count (still two counts, so a grant whose set name is NULL is counted), and `removeOrganizationAuthStructure` deletes exactly these grants, scoped to the organization. Both take `{ selfRegistrationSet }`; omitted, they behave as before.
- **The two callers pass the set the audience declares when the delete runs**, read through `AuthManager#getAudience()`, the one live source of the audience: the `hooks.before` admission (`assertOrganizationDeletable`) and `beforeDeleteOrganization`. `getAudience` joins the `ActorGuardHost`, `PluginListHost` and `OrganizationPluginHost` picks, each typed as the class member.
- **Unchanged:** every grant of any other set still counts and refuses the delete; the Default Organization's delete (the last-administrator guard, then its own count, with none of its structure removed); the engine's own refusal while any row names the organization. Nothing is re-exported, so the published surface does not move.

Why this side of the card's two shapes: the grant is an organization row by ADR-0131 D3 ("Assignments are organization rows, in every posture"), so not stamping it with an organization would need that ADR changed; and the authorization resolver applies a stored grant only while its organization is the active tenant (`grantAppliesInTenant`, `packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts`; "There is no 'every organization' mode"). Once its organization is deleted the grant confers nothing anywhere, so removing it with the organization changes nothing the person can do in another organization. The organization-create gate reads the tenancy posture and `OS_ORG_LIMIT`'s count of owned memberships, never a grant.

## Tests

- **Door, booted (`self-registration-grant-first-membership-walled.dogfood.test.ts`, the existing walled self-registration rig: CRM, `posture-only` = `isolated`, audience `open` with `member_default` declared).** The registrant already self-registers and creates two organizations there; four cases follow:
  - the grant applies only where it is stamped: a `direct` origin for the set with the first organization active, none with the second, none with no organization;
  - a grant of another set (`crm_sales_user`) in the first organization still refuses: 409 `DELETE_RESTRICTED`, `dependents` exactly `[{ sys_user_permission_set, 1 }]` (the self-registration grant beside it is not counted), the organization and the grant still there;
  - with that grant removed, the first organization deletes with 200; no grant names it; the registrant's resolved positions, permission sets and their origins with the second organization active, and with none active, equal what they were before the delete; one membership left, in the second organization;
  - control: the second organization deletes with 200.
- **Seam (`organization-delete.test.ts`, one new top-level describe, six cases):** the set list with and without a declared set, deduplicated; the count leaves the self-registration grant out and still counts another set and a NULL-named grant; the same rows counted in full with no set declared; an organization holding only its admin and self-registration grants owns no records; the removal deletes the organization's self-registration grant and leaves another set's grant and the same set in another organization; with no set declared, only the admin grants go.

<details><summary>Reproduction on main, before the fix</summary>

The door file above, at `1c75fa66` (the tests alone, over `main` `ee230a25`'s plugin-auth): 2 failed, 5 passed. The delete of the first organization answered the card's exact body:

```
{"code":"DELETE_RESTRICTED","message":"This organization still owns records in sys_user_permission_set (1). Delete or move those records first, then delete the organization.","dependents":[{"object":"sys_user_permission_set","count":1}]}: expected 409 to be 200
```

and with the business grant added the count was 2, not 1. The second organization deleted with 200 on `main` too, and the grant's origin case (`direct` in the first organization only) passed on `main`: that one is a measurement of the current resolver, not of the fix.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each mutation through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; restore proved by blob == HEAD)</summary>

- Count exempts every grant (`others = tenantGrants - tenantGrants`): 3 seam cases red, including "every grant of any other set still is" counted.
- Removal drops its `organization_id` filter: 2 red, including "the same set in another organization stays".
- The declared set ignored by `organizationAuthStructureSetNames`: 4 red.
- Door: `beforeDeleteOrganization` passes a set name that matches nothing (plugin-auth rebuilt, marker proved in `dist/` by `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, then rebuilt and proved absent): the first-organization delete answered 409 from the engine's own refusal (`sys_user_permission_set (1)` still naming the organization), red; the other six cases green.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Which set is "the self-registration set" is read when the delete runs.** A grant of a set the deployment declared for self-registrants earlier but no longer declares (or a deployment since closed to self-registration) is counted like any other grant, and the delete answers 409 naming it, with the existing remedy. A grant an administrator gave by hand of the very set the audience declares is left out and removed with the organization too: the table records no other distinction, and like every grant of a deleted organization it confers nothing afterwards.
- **The Default Organization keeps its own path.** Under `single` the self-registration grant lands on the Default Organization, whose delete removes none of its structure and counts its grants; this PR does not touch that path.
- **Not read here: `objectstack-ai/cloud`.** The card's set (`cloud_control_plane_member`) is configured in cloud's control-plane preset, and that repository is outside this session. Every evaluator of the grant in this repository applies it only in its own organization; whether cloud reads the row anywhere else was not measured.

## Verification

All on head `91d2649e` (this branch with `main` merged once; the branch's delta against `main` is exactly the 8 files of this PR) unless named otherwise.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 78 derived families, every one `exit 0`; `--ran` reconciliation: 78 derived, 78 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero), 0 UNRUN. The dogfood closure and the eight dists `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` reads were built first, and the pinned fixture commit of `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` was fetched, so no gate answered exit 3.
- `pnpm lint` (eslint over the whole repository, `--no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0 (including `check:test-typecheck`, the ledger unchanged).
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth` full suite under the verify lock, on `b5af817d` (before the merge, which touches no plugin-auth file): 265 files, 4947 passed, 10 skipped. On `91d2649e`: `organization-delete`, `organization-delete-read-fault`, `self-registration-grant-first-membership`, `last-admin-guard` and `remove-member-permission-guard`, 5 files / 158 tests passed.
- Dogfood, on `91d2649e`, against freshly built dists: `self-registration-grant-first-membership-walled`, `organization-delete-refuse-nonempty`, `organization-delete-federated-fixture` and `org-record-admin-reach`, 4 files / 28 tests passed.
